title: Legend of Exorcism
description: After leaving Yaojin Palace, Kong Hongjun arrives in Chang’an to battle demons and forms a bond with exorcism squad chief Li Jinglong.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Sent to the mortal world, Hongjun must report to the Exorcism Department, find his father's killers, and retrieve the Heart Lamp. He fights a Flying Mastiff before arriving in the capital.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Hongjun shatters his divine shield upon meeting Captain Li Jinglong, accidentally merging a rare pendant into Li's body. Meanwhile, the Emperor plots to put Li in charge of exorcisms.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Hongjun, Mo Rigen, Atai, and Yongsi meet at the department. Jinglong arrives angry but is knocked out by mistake. Once awake, he assumes command and starts a massive renovation.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The team buys the Wisdom Sword and investigates a missing cat. While staking out a brothel, they find fox fur and a dried corpse, while Lady Guo secretly drains palace maids.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Using music as bait, the team corners three hidden fox demons. Jinglong and Hongjun team up in a fierce street battle to slay the demon Jin Yun after city guards are wiped out.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The team tracks a lone demon to the palace. Later, an infatuated guard frees a captured fox demon, leading to a final ambush where the vengeful demon Fei Ao is cornered and killed.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: During a treacherous night battle at the imperial palace, the magical Shanhe Brush displays its immense, universe-shaping power as the entire Exorcism Department faces a deadly crisis.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Sinister demons infiltrate the Imperial Academy, causing dark currents to surge during the autumn exams. The Exorcism Department launches a high-stakes hunt across the grounds.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Li Jinglong uncovers a massive, deep-rooted conspiracy orchestrated by the fox clan. Amid a lively celebration by the poetic railings, hidden dangers lurk just out of sight.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: A wave of frequent, brutal murders plagues the city of Chang'an. Inner demons grow stronger as the entire family of Qin Wu is ruthlessly exterminated by dark forces.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Deep, hidden mysteries are uncovered within the mystical Sumeru Mustard Seed. The entire Exorcism Department falls victim to a terrifying and deceptive Blood Luo illusion.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: A dangerous dragon offspring emerges from the shattered Blood Luo illusion to steal human souls. Simultaneously, the legendary Golden-Winged Roc appears over Chang'an.

episodes_data.title: Legend of Exorcism Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: The powerful Heart Lamp erupts, allowing the Chief Historian to slay a dragon. The Exorcism Department fights to protect the Emperor during a final showdown with the Fox King.
